Title: All six products show the same dog photo for problem_user
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open saucedemo.com.
2. Log in as problem_user with the password shown on the login page.
3. Look at the product images on the Products page.
4. Log in as standard_user in another tab and compare.
Expected Behavior: Each product shows its own image, as it does for standard_user.
Actual Behavior: All six products show the same photo of a dog.
Notes: Practice site with seeded issues. Product detail pages were not checked for problem_user.

Title: Checkout accepts a one-letter postal code ('o') and completes the order
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in as standard_user.
2. Add Backpack, Bike Light and Bolt T-Shirt to the cart.
3. Open the cart and click Checkout.
4. Enter First Name 'a', Last Name 'a', Zip/Postal Code 'o'.
5. Click Continue, then Finish.
Expected Behavior: The postal code is checked for a valid format and length, and the user cannot continue with 'o'.
Actual Behavior: No error is shown. The Overview page opens and the order completes with 'Thank you for your order!'.
Notes: The field is labelled Zip/Postal Code and postal codes can contain letters in some countries, so the expected result is a format and length check, not digits only. A single letter is not valid anywhere. One-letter first and last names are also accepted, which looks doubtful but may be intended.

Title: Error state stays on filled fields and after the user corrects them
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in as standard_user, add an item and open Checkout.
2. Type 'b' in First Name only and click Continue.
3. Look at the three fields and the red banner.
4. Type 'b' in Last Name and Zip/Postal Code without clicking Continue.
Expected Behavior: Only the field with the problem is marked red. The error clears once the user fixes it.
Actual Behavior: The First Name field, which is filled, also gets a red outline and icon. The banner says only 'Last Name is required'. After step 4 the red outlines and the banner stay until Continue is clicked again.
Notes: Only one missing field is reported at a time, which is a separate small point.

Title: Add to cart does nothing for three of the six products (problem_user)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open saucedemo.com in a normal window.
2. Log in as problem_user.
3. On the Products page, click Add to cart on all six products one by one.
4. Check the button on each product and the cart badge.
Expected Behavior: All six buttons change to Remove and the cart badge shows 6.
Actual Behavior: Backpack, Bike Light and Onesie change to Remove and the badge shows 3. Bolt T-Shirt, Fleece Jacket and Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt stay on Add to cart and are not added.
Reproducibility: Always (same three products in two runs, 2026-11-03 and 2026-11-07, in two different browser profiles)
Notes: S04_add_to_cart_before.png is from the second run and shows the empty cart before the six clicks. The three added items could not be removed again (see S-06). Not compared with standard_user in this run.

Title: Sort dropdown has no effect and snaps back to 'Name (A to Z)' (problem_user)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in as problem_user.
2. Open the sort dropdown at the top right of the Products page.
3. Choose one option at a time: Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), Price (high to low).
4. Look at the dropdown label and the order of the products.
Expected Behavior: The chosen option stays selected and the products are reordered.
Actual Behavior: The dropdown goes back to 'Name (A to Z)' and the products stay in the A to Z order for every option I tried.
Notes: A single screenshot looks the same as the default page, so the recording is the better evidence here. Not compared with standard_user in this run.

Title: Remove button on the Products page does nothing (problem_user)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in as problem_user.
2. Add Backpack and Bike Light to the cart (the buttons change to Remove).
3. Click Remove on Backpack, then on Bike Light, 3 to 4 times in total.
4. Look at the buttons and the cart badge.
Expected Behavior: The button goes back to Add to cart and the badge count goes down.
Actual Behavior: Nothing changes. The button stays Remove and the badge stays at 3.
Reproducibility: Always (3 to 4 clicks on different products; repeated in a second browser profile on 2026-11-07)
Notes: Remove on the cart page was not tested. The screenshots show the cursor on the button; the recording is the better evidence.

Title: Typing in Last Name overwrites First Name and Last Name stays empty, so checkout cannot continue (problem_user)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in as problem_user, add Backpack and open the cart.
2. Click Checkout.
3. Type 'Test' in First Name.
4. Click Last Name and type 'User'.
5. Look at both fields, then type 12345 in Zip/Postal Code and click Continue.
Expected Behavior: First Name stays 'Test', Last Name shows 'User' and Continue opens the Overview page.
Actual Behavior: First Name is replaced by the characters typed in Last Name and ends as 'r'. Last Name stays empty. Continue shows 'Error: Last Name is required', so the order cannot be placed.
Reproducibility: Always (seen on 2026-11-03, 11-06 and 11-07, including a second browser profile)
Notes: The Last Name error message is correct for an empty field; the defect is that the field cannot be filled. standard_user accepts a Last Name in the same form (see S-02). Chrome autofill was on in this profile, but the overwrite happens while typing.
